generic-switch.snmprec
  Synthetic data written by hand from the public MIB definitions (SNMPv2-MIB
  system group, IF-MIB ifTable/ifXTable incl. 64-bit HC counters, RFC 1213 /
  RFC 2863 / RFC 2233 object semantics). Models a 3-port switch.
  Also contains HOST-RESOURCES-MIB (hrProcessorLoad, hrStorage RAM),
  ENTITY-MIB entPhysicalTable, ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB entPhySensorTable,
  BRIDGE-MIB dot1dBasePortIfIndex, Q-BRIDGE-MIB dot1qTpFdbTable and
  dot1qVlanStaticTable, LLDP-MIB lldpRemTable/lldpRemManAddrTable,
  IP-MIB ipNetToPhysicalTable and IP-FORWARD-MIB inetCidrRouteTable, with a
  few deliberately malformed rows (short MAC, wrong address length prefix, empty
  chassis id, unmapped bridge port, control characters in a name).
  NOT captured from hardware. sysObjectID uses the documentation enterprise
  number 32473 (RFC 5612) so that no vendor driver claims it.

generic-router.snmprec
  Synthetic data written by hand from the public MIB definitions. Models a
  2-port router exposing only the legacy tables: 32-bit IF-MIB ifTable (no
  ifXTable), IP-MIB ipNetToMediaTable, BRIDGE-MIB dot1dTpFdbTable and
  IP-FORWARD-MIB ipCidrRouteTable (one row with a non-contiguous mask).
  NOT captured from hardware. sysObjectID uses the documentation enterprise
  number 32473 (RFC 5612); addresses are documentation ranges (RFC 5737).

eltex-mes.snmprec
  Synthetic data written by hand, modelling an Eltex MES switch as described in
  "MES Ethernet switches monitoring and configuration via SNMP", firmware 6.6.2
  (Eltex), sections 4.1 "System resources" (rlCpuUtilDuringLastMinute) and
  4.2 "System parameters" (rlPhdUnitEnvParamTable power supply states, rlEnv
  temperature readings), plus the standard system group and IF-MIB counters.
  sysObjectID 1.3.6.1.4.1.35265.1.65535 is a placeholder under elHardware
  (ELTEX-SMI-ACTUAL); no real MES model OID is documented or implied. sysDescr
  follows the LLDP example in the MES23xx/33xx/35xx/5324 user manual 4.0.22.
  One temperature row (500) is deliberately out of range.
  NOT captured from hardware; values not verified on a real device.

eltex-esr.snmprec
  Synthetic data written by hand, modelling an Eltex ESR router as described in
  ESR-series Documentation 1.23, "Мониторинг системных параметров"
  (docs.eltex-co.ru pageId=485130258): sysDescr format, CISCO-PROCESS-MIB
  cpmCPUTotal1min per core (one out-of-range core), CISCO-MEMORY-POOL-MIB
  ciscoMemoryPoolValid/Used/Free (one invalid pool), rlPhdUnitEnvParamTable
  temperature value/status
  pairs (one sensor not ok), plus IF-MIB counters and IP-FORWARD-MIB
  inetCidrRouteTable. sysObjectID 1.3.6.1.4.1.35265.1.65534 is a placeholder
  under elHardware (ELTEX-SMI-ACTUAL); no real ESR model OID is documented or
  implied. Addresses are documentation ranges (RFC 5737).
  NOT captured from hardware; values not verified on a real device.
